profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Typescript, React,  JavaScript, Ruby, Golang, Node.js, Vue,js, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Selenium,  Jest, Protobuf, MQTT, Rust, AWS, Python, React-Testing-Library, Webpack, Babel, Deck.gl, Nebula.gl, Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Docker, Enzyme, Mocha/Chai, Microsoft Azure, Express, HTML/CSS, Styled Components, Figma, Yarn, NPM, Adobe Creative Cloud

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created a React/JavaScript app using Deck.gl and Nebula.gl to display information with the ability to edit existing and add new features. 
Created to view and interact with embedded devices in real time using React, MQTT and TypeScript.
Wrote python scripts to help run tests, and local development setup and execution.
Devised user stories, designed mockups, and created prototypes for potential web applications.
Implemented test suites with Jest, React-Testing-Library and Selenium for unit and end-to-end testing. 
Developed Rust code to support frontend requirements.
Converted existing code into TypeScript.
Deployed web applications with AWS and implemented SSO.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineering Immersive Resident
positions.description:
Mentor students in developing the problem solving process and troubleshoot technical problems
Instruct students on JavaScript fundamentals, full-stack engineering concepts 
Assess and grade student code, communication skills, and provide feedback to drive positive outcomes

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Bujourney - productivity tracker MERN application
positions.description:
- Designed productivity and task tracker with React, Bootstrap, MongoDB, and Express / Node
- Utilized Yelp, National Parks, Petfinder, and Spotify API to create an activity recommendation feature
- Implemented unit and integration testing with Jest and Enzyme

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer - Fjords - Optimize and scale backend legacy code for PERN application
positions.description:
- Redesigned inherited codebase to support query speeds of 64ms with PostgreSQL
- Utilized Nginx as load balancer with EC2 and AMI to horizontally scale service, increasing throughput from 900rps to 1500rps
- Leveraged K6, Loader.io and New Relic for stress testing
Tech: Postgres, Express, React, Node, AWS EC2 S3 AMI, New Relic, Jest + Enzyme, K6, Loader.io

positions.title: Full Stack Developer - AXlia - A MERN application for displaying and browsing homes
positions.description:
- Developed responsive user controls for item carousel using Conditional Rendering and JS to predict end of user scroll for smooth scrolling
- Utilized Styled Components so initial page load reduces requests to server and latency from 3s to under a second
- Deployed microservices with Docker to AWS EC2 to allow for reduced coupling
- Created responsive and dynamic web application with service-oriented architecture
-Leveraged Jest + Enzyme for unit and integration testing to prevent regression
Tech: MongoDB, Express, Node, React, Styled Components, Jest, Enzyme, AWS, Docker

positions.title: Digital Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Create strategy to organize and streamline marketing materials and training processes
Create spreadsheets for project archives, content calendars, and understudy program
Provide trainings for clients on the different aspects of digital marketing
Create a master database to connect Google Drive, Asana, and other programs 
Review and edit materials and spreadsheets

positions.title: Event Manager
positions.description:
Process ticket sales and other transactions, data entry,  and respond to customer inquiries
Provide front of house management for Morrison Concerts, chamber performances, and graduations
Prepare spaces for events, lectures, and music rehearsals (carrying and transporting heavy objects unassisted)
Respond and solve guest and client issues while providing a high level of customer service
Manage a small staff of ushers and crowds ranging from 200-1000 per event

positions.title: Marketing and Events Intern
positions.description:
Create social media captions for Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram
Review and edit media, informational material, Excel sheets
Assist in setup for performances, gala, and performances
Write video scripts and brainstorm questions for promotional material
Assemble letters, and appeals to be sent out
Research Merola Alumni to promote post program events
Summer 2019 events: Schwabacher Summer Concerts, If I Were You (World Premiere) and Merola Grand Finale

positions.title: Box Office Staff
positions.description:
Process Ticket Reservations and Sales, and Answer customer inquiries through email and telephone
Connect clients with the appropriate department or staff
Data-entry input in Google Sheets
